title: BSU students won prizes at the Interuniversity Olympiad in Psychology

blocks.text: On May 17, 2025, students of the Psychology program of the Social and Psychological Faculty of the Bishkek State University named after K. Karavaev took part in the III Interuniversity Student Olympiad in Psychology. The event was held at the Kyrgyz-Russian Slavic University named after B. Yeltsin and brought together teams from the country's leading universities: BSU, KNU, KRSU, KRAO and Ala-Too.

Following the results of the Olympiad, the BSU team worthily represented the university and took the honorable second place. We congratulate our students and teachers on their high result and wish them new scientific achievements!
©️ Perizat Aitbaeva – Dean of the Faculty of Social and Psychological Sciences
